hook.line: This is how you start digital marketing free to make $500 to $1,000 days.
hook.visual: Close-up of a woman pointing a finger at camera; boxed title 'How To Start Digital Marketing For Free' mid-frame, bold word-by-word captions under it.

beats.what: Money claim plus title card; she asks viewers to save the video.
Cut to filmed laptop: step 1, set up a social account, her TikTok profile shown.
Step 2: open Canva AI and paste a prompt; she tells viewers to screenshot it.
Zoom punch as Canva starts coding the digital product.
Step 3: Google 'Stan Store' and sign up.
Add product > Digital Product, fill in title and price ($27).
Paste the store link into her profile bio.
Last step: make faceless or face-forward content promoting the product.
Payoff: tour of the interactive budget tracker Canva generated.
Comment CTA: drop 'ready' below to learn her method.

why_it_works: Dollar figure in the first 6 s plus 'save this video' sets up a long, save-worthy tutorial.
A finger on the real screen shows exactly where to tap, so the steps are easy to follow on a phone.
The finished product is revealed at the end, rewarding viewers who stayed through 3 minutes of steps.
Comment keyword 'ready' turns the CTA into an engagement signal.
weaknesses: 177 s with a 40.93 s longest shot; the middle steps drag.
Result is shown last instead of first, so there is less pull to stay early on.
Filmed laptop screen is dense (median 62 words on screen) and hard to read at phone size.
for_robert: Avoid saving the result for the end of a long tutorial: show the finished thing in the first seconds, then the steps; Fred could point at the screen like her finger does.
